_header: Parity fixture for the pure half of
crates/daemon/src/commands/state/models.rs ->
llm-sidecar/src/commands/model_settings.ts.
Generated by driving the real Rust in a throwaway worktree at
9023b46d (the last commit where the daemon crate builds), WITH THE
DREAMING REMOVAL APPLIED. models.rs is not byte-identical between
9023b46d and the commit this ports at — the whole difference is
that `BackgroundTask` lost its third variant — so the worktree's
copy of models.rs is HEAD's, and `BackgroundTask::Dreaming` was
dropped from the common crate to make it compile. Nothing else in
the file differs, and nothing this fixture covers touches
BackgroundTask at all; the two functions that do are pinned
separately with the rest of the command surface.
The generator is not committed; nothing regenerates this file. A
later diff against it is a defect, not a fixture to update.
Every case here is a pure function of its arguments. The sampler
cases run twice — once on an empty settings block and once on one
with all fourteen fields already set — because 'null clears the
field' and 'null was already the value' are the same answer on an
empty block, and a rejected write leaving the old value alone is
invisible there too. `before` and `after` are both recorded, so a
parser that writes on the way to failing is caught.
The capability grid is every sdk x six model ids x every settable
key, recorded whole rather than sampled. The ids are the ones that
move an id-sensitive rule: the Claude sampler cutoff sits between
4-7 and 4-8, and two are `[[model_override]]` substring matches.
